name: Wollar Solar Farm
notable: 280 MW solar farm near Mudgee, NSW. Developed by Lightsource BP. Located in the Central-West Orana REZ.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

timeline.title: COD estimate updated
timeline.detail: COD changed from 2025-11 to 2025-11-21 (source: AEMO Generation Information)

eis_specs.document_title: Wollar Solar Farm Environmental Impact Statement (SSD-9254) - Sunterra Energy
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: New TransGrid 330 kV substation in NE corner of site, cut in to existing 330 kV OHL (adjacent to Wollar 500/330 kV switching station)
eis_specs.connection_augmentation: New TransGrid-operated 330 kV substation in NE corner of site
eis_specs.notes: Sunterra Energy. ~290 MWac (280-290 MWac range), up to ~800,000 modules; tracker vs fixed-tilt to be decided post-consent. Consent 24 February 2020. Original 30 MWh BESS materially upsized via MOD-4 (2024-26) to 280 MW / 560 MWh. Site ~7 km south of Wollar village.
